body:
This exposes an issue in the multi-texture system: When loaded, the "storage" textures are located in VRAM, then copied into the system memory and used to create the "combined" texture. The "storage" textures will unnecessarily still reside in VRAM alongside the actually used "combined" texture. 

Additionally, when using the Compatibility renderer the textures will become both uncompressed and converted to RGBA8. This is a consequence of how array textures are downloaded from the GPU under OpenGL.

@BlueCube3310 partially fixes the issue. I could bake at 15 in the MRP but in the same project with textures and materials it crashes when "Retrieving textures" happen. There is no output in the console

Edit: I test it at 12 and bakes but at 15 crashes when retrieving textures. Non directional bakes and retrieves textures fine and both texel densities
